A player keeps the place-totems-and-watch-it-erupt feel; the multi-totem-shared-fuse bookkeeping is generalized.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: TOTEM-DELIVERED FUSE-STACK: Ballista Totems stack Explosive Arrow fuses (up to 20) into one target, detonating for a massive ignite while the player runs free (dossier skill_loop; probe delivery 'at-target' but movement 'run/full-move' + mech_note 'totem-delivered' -> the TOTEM is the delivery chassis). §7.2 dominant-loop: the player's active job is PLACING TOTEMS (the totems auto-fire), so totem geometry leads; ground_targeted_circle is the detonation burst (secondary). The 20-fuse-stack-then-detonate maps NATIVELY to accumulator (accumulator_max=20, fill on-hit-dealt = each arrow adds a fuse, discharge at cap OR on target death per 'instantly triggering the explosion' — verify_ledger). T4 PROXY_ASCENSION (totem/ballista proxy delivery, §5 minion/totem hiero) + PERSISTENCE_ENGINE_saturation (the fuse-saturation-then-burst reading). CAPSTONE ABSTAINED — t4 routed from core identity (totem-proxy delivery + fuse-saturation) + probe (cooldown economy, hp-stack defense) per fallback. Element fire->burn (probe 'burn', damage_mode hybrid = hit+ignite). The fuse-stack lives on ONE target across MULTIPLE totems' arrows — this is a shared-accumulator-on-defender, at MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=1 (each arrow-add is a single fill event, not a nested chain); within the invariant.
